pretreatment: HF etching, chemical oxidation, thermal oxidation
evidence: All Ti–silicate were deposited on 2 in. Si(100) wafers. The wafer surface was prepared in three different ways: (i) the native oxide was stripped in a 1% HF solution, resulting in a H-passivated Si surface; (ii) a wet chemical oxide was grown using a piranha solution, which is a mixture of 50% sulfuric acid and 30% hydrogen peroxide in a 7:3 volume ratio; and (iii) a thermal oxide was grown after an HF dipping by rapid thermal oxidation (RTO).
